request.text: 您好，{name}：感谢您分享需求。我们预计周五前提供修订后的方案，最终交付时间仍需双方确认。若您有新的要求，请直接回复此邮件。谢谢，{name}。
request.style: 礼貌、清晰的商务邮件；保留占位符

initial_translation: Good morning, {name}: Thank you for sharing your requirements. We anticipate providing the revised plan by Thursday and final delivery time still requires confirmation from both of us. Please reply directly to this email if you have any new requests. Thanks, {name}.
revised_translation: Good morning, {name}: Thank you for sharing your requirements. We anticipate providing the revised plan by Thursday and final delivery time still requires confirmation from both of us. Please reply directly to this email if you have any new requests. Thanks, {name}.

rule_checks.method: 术语按区分大小写的字面子串匹配，仅检查原文出现的术语；占位符按原样及出现次数比较。规则结果不是整体翻译质量评分。
